items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: the first time I went in there, looking at him and Carnish, and Buddy, Bollin, and Bob Lyons, all of the players.

ctx.x: He just hit the notes. Oh yeah.

Yeah, I never did see him read a piece of music though. Well, one time I went to see him play at the, at the old fellas hall, and I sit down there, and I sit down there, I sit down there, and the first time I went in there, looking at him and Carnish, and Buddy, Bollin, and Bob Lyons, all of the players. I sit down there, but I must be having my mouth open. And sitting down there, you know, I had my mouth open looking at them playing. But after I got up from playing, I must have had dust in here. I did like that,…
Oh yeah, you've been just so interested.
